font.reason: Neutral, modern UI sans suited to the product feature heading. Loaded through FaRoot so the Persian title renders in the intended font. The other two demos use text-free gray fixture geometry; the same root provides a stable RTL/font context without adding copy.

rtlDecisions.action: Translated to «ویژگی‌ها», set RTL and right-aligned against the card wall's right edge.
rtlDecisions.why: The only visible label is a product feature heading; the right edge is the RTL reading start.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored the three card columns so the activation order begins at the right; seeds and row order remain unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: The sequential wall reveal follows reading order.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored the SVG rectangle's horizontal path direction in its own bounds.
rtlDecisions.why: The perimeter highlight now starts from the right edge while retaining its 8-frame traversal.
They express physical vertical movement and camera motion, not reading direction.

rtlDecisions.action: Used Vazirmatn at 70px rendered size (64px source size scaled by faText), variable weight 700, and zero letter spacing.
rtlDecisions.why: A neutral UI face fits the source heading; a variable family supports the original strong title hierarchy.

compositions.rasterHandling: No raster or video assets. Card content is gray placeholder geometry without baked-in text.
compositions.timing: All source frames, easing curves, activation intervals, seeds, and camera scale timing preserved.
compositions.visualVerification: Compared Persian and original at frame 100; checked the title, mirrored sequence, aligned card bounds, and final wall.

rtlDecisions.action: Used RTL grid placement so the DOM's first card occupies the rightmost column; diagonal delay is computed from the RTL column index.
rtlDecisions.why: The diagonal wave is a sequence of content reveals, so its first-to-last progression follows Persian reading order.
These describe physical card rotation, depth and light rather than reading direction.

rtlDecisions.action: No on-screen strings exist in this demo; loaded Vazirmatn in the RTL root without injecting visible copy.
rtlDecisions.why: The source is a text-free placeholder card wall, and adding words would change its design.

compositions.rasterHandling: No raster or video assets. Both faces are generated gray placeholder shapes with no text.
compositions.timing: All 20-frame hold, 6-frame diagonal stagger, 14-frame flips, last-card overshoot/settle, easing, and seeds preserved.
compositions.visualVerification: Compared Persian and original at frame 44; verified centered wall geometry and the right-to-left first wave. Frame 100 still was rendered for the comp but not separately inspected.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored the SVG blueprint and the text-free dashboard geometry horizontally; set the dashboard fixture's local direction to LTR before mirroring to avoid a double RTL flex reversal.
rtlDecisions.why: The sidebar and dashboard column order are layout semantics and belong on the right for Persian readers.

rtlDecisions.action: Changed the scan position to move right-to-left and mirrored the entity clip edge to match the same scan progress.
rtlDecisions.why: The reveal follows reading direction; the bright scan line remains aligned to the materialization boundary.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored the chart with the rest of the interface; retained all generated points and seed math.
rtlDecisions.why: The chart is a category/layout element embedded in the dashboard, while its data values and generation remain unchanged.

rtlDecisions.action: No visible text strings exist in the dashboard or SVG; Vazirmatn is loaded at the root without adding copy.
rtlDecisions.why: The source art consists solely of placeholder bars, shapes and a line chart.

compositions.rasterHandling: No raster or video assets. Dashboard is rendered from vector/DOM placeholder geometry and contains no baked text.
compositions.timing: All source draw group start times, per-item offsets, scan frames 88–118, opacity beats, easing and seeds preserved.
compositions.visualVerification: Compared Persian and original at frame 100; confirmed the mirrored sidebar, right-to-left scan, and registered clip boundary.
